THC Living Plant Atlas — Trichomes & Resin expansion release expectations

- Trichomes & Resin contains 10 canonical lessons after this expansion.
- Whole Atlas contains 80 canonical lessons after Flowers and Trichomes expansions.
- Every canonical lesson has exactly one knowledge-check route.
- New routes:
  /learn/atlas/trichomes-resin/stalked-trichome-development
  /learn/atlas/trichomes-resin/head-stipe-and-stalk-specialization
  /learn/atlas/trichomes-resin/secretory-cell-metabolism-and-storage-interface
  /learn/atlas/trichomes-resin/gland-aging-dehiscence-and-sampling-integrity
- Each new route has direct scholarly source mappings and a visual-production brief.
- Trichome entity remains modelTarget plant.trichomes.
- Micro title: Secretory disk, cavity, stipe & stalk.
- Data title: Development, specialization & sampling.
- Sessile-like precursor stages must not be described as meaning every sessile gland becomes stalked.
- Stalk functional claims must stay within evidence from current multi-omics; do not invent transport fluxes or a proven vascular conduit.
- Storage cavity is extracellular/subcuticular, not the secretory cell itself.
- Clear/cloudy/amber appearance is not a direct potency assay.
- Gland aging, dehiscence, damage, tissue position, genotype, focus and lighting must remain part of sampling interpretation.
